Subject: Novapath — product demo (Nov 12)

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks again for scheduling the product walkthrough for Nov 12 at 11:00 AM ET. Two quick updates from our side: our VP product has pushed an internal roadmap review into the week and is asking that any external demos be moved off Nov 12 if possible so they can attend the review in the same time window.

Separately, we may have a conflict on our side with an investor Q&A that just came up for a couple of execs (Ethan copied). Not sure yet if it will overlap — wanted to flag it early rather than cancel last-minute.

Can you confirm whether the SE can move to any alternate slots next week? If not, we can still proceed but may need to reschedule if the execs are required.

Appreciate the flexibility — Olivia

--
Olivia Parker
Director, Product Operations | Novapath
olivia.parker@novapath.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novapath — product demo (Nov 12)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up.

Short answer: we can absolutely accommodate a move. Quick context on our side: Karthik (SE) is scheduled to be onsite with another customer the week of Nov 11–13 and will be traveling on Nov 12, so he won't be available live. I’ve looped Monica who can cover as the live SE if that works for you — she’s familiar with the connector and the ROI stories you care about.

If you prefer Karthik to lead, he can record a short walkthrough and we can do an asynchronous follow-up Q&A, but that is less ideal if you want an interactive deep-dive with your VP.

Proposed alternatives (all ET):
- Tue, Nov 16 — 11:00 AM (best for Karthik if he returns)
- Wed, Nov 17 — 09:00 AM or 2:00 PM (Monica available)
- Fri, Nov 19 — 11:00 AM (backup)

I attached an updated agenda and will re-send a new calendar invite once you pick a slot. Let us know whether to confirm Monica live (recommended) or reschedule for Karthik the week after.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (650) 555-0110
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Hi all — quick note from the SE perspective.

I will be onsite in Chicago from Nov 11 evening through Nov 13 evening supporting a P0 run for another customer; travel is firm (flight booked) so I can’t reliably join a live walkthrough on Nov 12. If the execs want an interactive demo and it’s important that I present, moving to Nov 16 would work.

If you need to keep it earlier, Monica is fully briefed and can run the demo. I’ll prepare a 10–15 minute handoff doc covering the following so Monica can cover my usual talking points:
- connector setup nuances for Novapath
- KPI examples (latency/cost tradeoffs) and quant quantization recommendations
- two customer stories: FinFlux and RidgeBank (one-pager)

I can also record a 20-min walkthrough (unlisted link) by EOD Nov 15 to supplement.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Parker <olivia.parker@novapath.com>

Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination. After checking with the VP team, we’d prefer to keep the demo live and have Monica present so our product and VP can join (their schedule opens on Nov 17). Can we lock Wed, Nov 17 at 2:00 PM ET? That slot works on our end.

Marissa — please confirm and send the updated invite. Karthik — if you can prepare the handoff bullets and the short recording by Nov 15, that would be ideal so Monica has time to review.

Confirming: Wed 17 Nov, 2:00 PM ET — Monica (SE) live, Marissa (AE) host, Karthik provide handoff & recording.

Best,
Olivia
